verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवं वृकांश्च तान्दृष्ट्वा वर्धमानान्दुरासदान्। सस्त्रीपुमान्स घोषो वै समस्तोऽमन्त्रयत्तदा॥१॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the eight chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the calculation of eras, time cycles.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाने नेह न नः कार्यं व्रजामोऽन्यन्महद्वनम्। यच्छिवं च सुखोष्यं च गवां चैव सुखावहम्॥२॥
verses.english: And another son of Sungod, the brother of manu, is shaniH-cara, who got planethood and worshipped by one and all...
verses.bhavadeepa: एतस्मिन्नवमेऽध्याये रामकृष्णेच्छया पुनः। वृन्दावनप्रवेशश्च व्रजस्याद्भुत ईर्यते॥१॥ एवं वृकान्॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: अद्यैव किं चिरेण स्म व्रजामः सह गोधनैः। यावद्वृकैर्वधं घोरं न नः सर्वो व्रजो व्रजेत्॥३॥
verses.english: Presently the form of Sungod is uniform, lengthwise and breadthwise, by which flatness he is termed as विभावसु...

verses.sanskrit: एषां धूम्रारुणाङ्गानां दंष्ट्रिणां नखकर्षिणाम्। वृकाणां कृष्णवक्त्राणां बिभीमो निशि गर्जताम्॥४॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the ninth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of vaivasvata-manu, the son of Sungod .

verses.sanskrit: मम पुत्रो मम भ्राता मम वत्सोऽथ गौर्मम। वृकैर्व्यापादिता ह्येवं क्रन्दन्ति स्म गृहे गृहे ॥५॥
verses.english: He who listens or memorises this episode narrating the emergence of these gods, his fear in calamity will e removed and he achieves great renown.

verses.sanskrit: तासां रुदितशब्देन गवां हम्भारवेण च। व्रजस्योत्थापनं चक्रुर्घोषवृद्धाः समागताः॥६॥
verses.english: With the granules erupted while toning down the radiance of Sungod on a lathe, tvaSTha, alias vishva-karma, prepared a disc, called viShNu-cakram, and gave it to shriihari, with an intention that his disc would eradicate all demons in battles...

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मतमथाज्ञाय गन्तुं वृन्दावनं प्रति। व्रजस्य विनिवेशाय गवां चैव हिताय च॥७॥
verses.english: Lady saMj~na, somehow tolerating the radiation of that supreme scorcher, namely Aditya, the Sun, gave rise to three of his children, one girl and two prajApati-s...

verses.sanskrit: वृन्दावननिवासाय ताञ्ज्ञात्वा कृतनिश्चयान्। नन्दगोपो बृहद्वाक्यं बृहस्पतिरिवाददे॥८॥
verses.english: Out of those two prajApati-s one is वैवस्वत prajApati, because he is the son of विवस्वान्, namely the Sun himself while the other is श्राद्ध-देव, presiding deity of obsequial oblations, namely यम, or also called शमन, the eternal silencer and the girl is a twin sister of yama, named as lady यमुन॥।

verses.sanskrit: अद्यैव निश्चयप्राप्तिर्यदि गन्तव्यमेव नः। शीघ्रमाज्ञाप्यतां घोषः सज्जीभवत मा चिरम्॥९॥
verses.english: Unable to further tolerate the irradiative aspect of Sun, which can be endured only through a hardship, then saMj~na created a form from out of her own shade, calling her lady cछाय...

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽवघुष्यत तदा घोषे तत्प्राकृतैर्जनैः। शीघ्रं गावः प्रकल्प्यन्तां भाण्डं समभिरोप्यताम्॥१०॥
verses.english: Because of that flatness, vivasvAn prajApati, namely Sungod, much appreciated the suggestion of tvaSTha, and permitted him to reshape his form, in order to get a pleasant form...

verses.sanskrit: वत्सयूथानि काल्यन्तां युज्यन्तां शकटानि च। वृन्दावनमितः स्थानान्निवेशाय च गम्यताम्॥११॥
verses.english: And oh, king, that lady cChAya, a completely artificial entity, emerged from out of the shade of lady saMj~na, stood before lady saMj~na with folded palms...
verses.bhavadeepa: अवघुष्यत घोषो जातः। भाण्डं शकटेष्विति शेषः॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा नन्दगोपस्य वचनं साधु भाषितम्। उदतिष्ठद्व्रजः सर्वः शीघ्रं गमनलालसः॥१२॥
verses.english: "Oh, lady with beautiful smile, tell me what I have to do...oh, lady with best complexion, here I am in your service...order me..." So said lady cChAya to saMj~na...

verses.sanskrit: प्रयाह्युत्तिष्ठ गच्छामः किं शेषे साधु योजय। उत्तिष्ठति व्रजे तस्मिन्गोपकोलाहलो ह्यभूत्॥१३॥
verses.english: Then saMj~na replied her saying, "I am going away to my father's house...in my place, you shall stay here, without becoming a rara avis - निर्-वि-कारया - these two are my sons, and this slender-waisted girl is my daughter, whom you have take under your care like me...and I believe, you won't reveal this arrangement to lord Sun, at anytime...

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठमानः शुशुभे शकटीशकटस्तु सः। व्याघ्रघोषमहाघोषो घोषः सागरघोषवान्॥१४॥
verses.english: "I will never, never reveal this arrangement, except in the case of someone catching me by my knead-hair, or someone hurling a curse at me...as such, oh. lady, you may go as you please and feel comfortable..." So said lady cChAya to lady saMj~na.

verses.sanskrit: गोपीनां गर्गरीभिश्च मूर्ध्नि चोत्तम्भितैर्घटैः। निष्पपात व्रजात्पङ्क्तिस्तारापङ्क्तिरिवाम्बरात्॥१५॥
verses.english: Instructing lady cChAya about dos and don'ts of household affairs, lady saMj~na reached her father's house, namely the house of tvaShTa, with a diffidence to leave her own house...

verses.sanskrit: नीलपीतारुणैस्तासां वस्त्रैरग्रस्तनोच्छ्रितैः। शक्रचापायते पङ्क्तिर्गोपीनां मार्गगामिनी॥१६॥
verses.english: And when she arrived in the presence of her father, namely tvaShTa, or vishva-karma, he spewed ire on her and demanded repeatedly that she should at once go to her husband...

verses.sanskrit: दामनी दामभारैश्च कैश्चित्कायावलम्बिभिः। गोपा मार्गगता भान्ति सावरोहा इव द्रुमाः॥१७॥
verses.english: And that unblemished lady saMj~na came out of her father's house also. Then, on donning a mare's form, ion which form she is called वडव, or बडब, she roamed in the places of Northern kuru kingdom, surviving on grass-blades...

verses.sanskrit: स व्रजो व्रजता भाति शकटौघेन भास्वता। पोतैः पवनविक्षिप्तैर्निष्पतद्भिरिवार्णवः॥१८॥
verses.english: Believing the replica of saMj~na as saMj~na herself, the Sun lived with her, begetting two selfsame sons through her...

verses.sanskrit: क्षणेन तद्व्रजस्थानमीरिणं समपद्यत। द्रव्यावयवनिर्धूतं कीर्णं वायसमण्डलैः॥१९॥
verses.english: From that seed of Sungod, which baDaba alias saMj~na sneezed off from her nose, there arose two gods, namely अश्विनि-कुमर-s. These are the twin gods who are the best among physicians. One is called न-असत्य, and the other दस्र...

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रमेण घोषः स प्राप्तो वृन्दावनं वनम्। निवेशं विपुलं चक्रे गवां चैव हिताय च॥२०॥
verses.english: Lady cChAya, the double of saMj~na, showed more affinity with her own children, and despised the elder children of her co-wife, with a sublunary complex...

verses.sanskrit: शकटावर्तपर्यन्तं चन्द्रार्धाकारसंस्थितम्। मध्ये योजनविस्तीर्णं तावद्द्विगुणमायतम्॥२१॥
verses.english: Out of the two sons of real saMj~na, the elder one, namely वैवस्वत, is able to tolerate the attitude of his stepmother cChAya, but the second one, namely शमन, or यम, did not tolerate her partial attitude owing to his exasperation, childhood, and her predominance...

verses.sanskrit: कण्टकीभिः प्रवृद्धाभिस्तथा कण्टकितद्रुमैः। निखातोच्छ्रितशाखाग्रैरभिगुप्तं समन्ततः॥२२॥
verses.english: And when he used to threaten her repeatedly, showing his foot at her as if to punt her...then, oh, king, lady cChAya coming into a fit of fury cursed yama saying. "let your foot break loose and fall down on earth..." yama is much perturbed by this curse, came to his father, namely the Sun, and reverently reported what all has happened as he is much alarmed by her words of curse.

verses.sanskrit: मन्थैरारोप्यमाणैश्च मन्थबन्धानुकर्षणैः। अद्भिः प्रक्षाल्यमानाभिर्गर्गरीभिरितस्ततः॥२३॥
verses.english: Knowing the curse as an irreversible one, yama spoke to his father Sun in this way, "a mother has to acquit herself equally among all sons...such as she is, she is discarding us and caring more for her sons...I confess that I raised my foot against her, but did not kick her at all...maybe I have done it childishly or foolishly...for that it will be apt of you to excuse me...I am your son, yet my feet are going to fall off undoubtedly...there may be a good son or a bad son, but there cannot be a bad mother...oh, lord, I have been cursed and about to loose my feet...oh, lord of living creatures, show grace on me and avert the situation..."

verses.sanskrit: कीलैरारोप्यमाणैश्च दामनीपाशपाशितैः। स्तम्भनीभिर्धृताभिश्च शकटैः परिवर्तितैः॥२४॥
नियोगपाशैरासक्तैर्गर्गरीस्तम्भमूर्धसु। छादनार्थं प्रकीर्णैश्च कटकैस्तृणसङ्कटैः॥२५॥
verses.english: As I cannot reverse your mother's words, let worms take pieces of flesh from your feet to earth, whereby your mother's words will come true, and you too can comfortably move on your feet as usual...further, you will be saved from the effect of curse also.." So said Sungod to his son, yama.

verses.sanskrit: शाखाविटङ्कैर्वृक्षाणां क्रियमाणैरितस्ततः। शोध्यमानैर्गवां स्थानैः स्थाप्यमानैरुलूखलैः॥२६॥
verses.english: Then, though Aditya, the Sungod, asked lady cChAya repeatedly, saying, "when all the children are to be treated equally, why do you show extra favour towards some only..." But she did not bother to reply him, every time she used to change the orientation of that topic with a derisive smile...
verses.bhavadeepa: नियोगपाशैः मन्थनभाण्डस्थूणाया मन्थदण्डेन संयोजनार्थैः पाशैः माञ्जेरेति महाराष्ट्रप्रसिद्धैः शिक्यैर्वा कटकैर्घटाधारकतृणैः सहिताभिः तृणसङ्कटैः तृणमयीभिराच्छादनीभिः॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: प्राङ्मुखैः सिच्यमानैश्च सन्दीप्यद्भिश्च पावकैः। स्वत्सचर्मास्तरणैः पर्यङ्कैश्चावरोपितैः॥२७॥
verses.english: Though he controlled himself for a long time, and much time has lapsed between his questioning and her derisive smiles, he did not find way out, or what has actually happened between mother and children is unknown to him. This roused a fit of anger in Sungod on certain occassion, and he caught hold of her hair-bun in order to curse her to elimination...

verses.sanskrit: तोयमुत्तारयन्तीभिः प्रेक्षन्तीभिश्च तद्वनम्। शाखाश्चाकर्षमाणाभिर्गोपीभिश्च समन्ततः॥२८॥
verses.english: When her hair is caught, cChAya had to reveal the secret pact between her and saMj~na, and she revealed everything as has happened. Sungod is further infuriated to listen all that and immediately came to tvaShTa, or vishva-karma, the father of saMj~na, in search of his wife, namely real saMj~na. On seeing him, tvaShTa revered his son-in-law Sungod according to custom, and pacified him who is hell-bent on burning everything down, as his wife is not in his proximity.

verses.sanskrit: युवभिः स्थविरैश्चैव गोपैर्व्यग्रकरैर्भृशम्। विशसद्भिः कुठारैश्च काष्ठान्यपि तरूनपि॥२९॥
verses.english: "Your form possessed with too much of radiance is not that pleasant...unable to tolerate such a form of yours, saMj~na is wandering on lawns...you can see your dear wife today itself, who is highly virtuous, always in an ascetic's mood, and who is wandering in the form of a mare...

verses.sanskrit: तद्व्रजस्थानमधिकं शुशुभे काननावृतम्। रम्यं वननिवेशं वै स्वादुमूलफलोदकम्॥३०॥
verses.english: विवस्वान्, namely the Sun, emerged from lady अदितिand kashyapa prajApati, where lady aditi is the daughter of daksha, hence called dAkshAyiNi... And the wife of vivasAn, namely Sungod, is lady संज्ञ,the daughter of त्वाSटृ prajApati ...

verses.sanskrit: तास्तु कामदुघा गावः सर्वपक्षिरुतं वनम्। वृन्दावनमनुप्राप्ता नन्दनोपमकाननम्॥३१॥
verses.english: If my advise of toning down your radiant form is acceptable to you, she obliges you, and I can finetune your radiance now itself to make it tolerably pleasant..." So said tvaSTha to Sungod.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमेव तु कृष्णेन गवां वै हितकारिणा। शिवेन मनसा दृष्टं तद्वनं वनचारिणा॥३२॥
verses.english: Presently the form of Sungod is uniform, lengthwise and breadthwise, by which flatness he is termed as विभावसु...

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे तु ततो रूक्षे धर्मे मासे निरामये। वर्षतीवामृतं देवे तृणं तत्र व्यवर्धत॥३३॥
verses.english: Because of that flatness, vivasvAn prajApati, namely Sungod, much appreciated the suggestion of tvaSTha, and permitted him to reshape his form, in order to get a pleasant form...

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र वत्साः सीदन्ति न गावो नेतरे जानाः। यत्र तिष्ठति लोकानां भवाय मधुसूदनः॥३४॥
verses.english: Then tvaSTha neared Sungod, placed him on a grindstone, and started to grind the radiance.

verses.sanskrit: ताश्च गावः स घोषस्तु स च सङ्कर्षणो युवा। कृष्णेन विहितं वासं समध्यासत निर्वृताः॥३५॥
verses.english: Then, on dulling the form and reducing the radiance, the Sungod's form became brightest from just bright, and it has become a pleasure to have a look at it...
